faqLeft.q: What engine does the Land Rover Defender Octa use?
faqLeft.a: The Defender Octa uses the BMW S68B44T0 — a 4.4-litre twin-turbo V8. It's the only BMW-sourced engine in the Defender range, sharing its architecture with BMW's S63/N63 hot-vee family.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Land Rover Defender Octa engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £6,500. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild S68 Defender Octa engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every S68 rebuild. The BMW hot-vee considerations are taken into account during inspection.

faqLeft.q: Do you supply used Defender Octa engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my Defender Octa if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does a Defender Octa engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most Defender Octa owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty — often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers.

form.guarantee: Most quotes returned within 30 minutes during working hours.
